properties.name: profile
properties.description: Returns the media mobilization profile for the specified media asset. Read-only.

properties.name: IsLinked
properties.description: Returns whether the sample is linked. Read-only.

properties.name: IsEmbedded
properties.description: Returns whether the sample is embedded. Read-only.

properties.name: AudioSamplingRate
properties.description: Returns the audio sampling rate per second. Read-only.

properties.name: VideoFrameRate
properties.description: Returns the video frame rate per second of the sample. Read-only.

properties.name: SampleHeight
properties.description: Returns the resolution height of the sample. Read-only.

properties.name: SampleWidth
properties.description: Returns the resolution width of the sample. Read-only.

properties.name: ContainerType
properties.description: Returns the format type of the container of the sample. Read-only.

properties.name: VideoCompressionType
properties.description: Returns the video compression format of the sample. Read-only.

properties.name: AudioCompressionType
properties.description: Returns the audio compression type. Read-only.

properties.name: Shape
properties.description: Returns the shape that is associated with the specified media asset. Read-only.
